note: Expected runner verdicts, written before the runs. Never shown to evaluated agents. Large-table scenario: run on MIGPROTO_SEED_DB=migproto_seed_scale; budget 500 ms per load write.

unsafe.json.why: One UPDATE holds row locks on every row until it commits, so concurrent old-app writes wait for the whole statement.

safe.json.why: Each batch locks only 10,000 rows briefly.

safe-with-default.json.why: Batches keep writers unblocked, and SET DEFAULT (new rows only) gives old-version inserts a value, so the new version can save them. Added after run 20261017-205806-staged showed the original safe plan left old-app inserts NULL; the original label is unchanged.
